write_up: This is a strong executive resume! Your progression from clinic operations at Midwest Physician Alliance to COO at Lakeshore Dental Partners is easy to follow, and you show both the scale of your work and what changed under your leadership.

The integration playbook line is a great model: it names the change you made and the reduction in integration time. Your current role also gives a recruiter the practice count, workforce, revenue and board reporting they need to understand the job.

Add how you reduced appointment waits, then consider whether you can show decisions beyond operations for a CEO search. Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a call; competition for executive roles and referrals can matter too.

cards.line: - Reduced patient wait time to third available appointment from 21 days to 6 across primary care
